description: Source code for Kubernetes API server's custom resource discovery controller, managing CRD discovery and registration.

classes.name: DiscoveryController
classes.description: Controller managing CRD discovery and registration in Kubernetes API server.

methods.name: NewDiscoveryController
methods.description: Constructor for DiscoveryController, initializes event handlers and queue.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes discovery information for a specific API group version.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the discovery controller, waits for cache sync, performs initial sync, and runs worker.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes items from the work queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Handles one item from the queue, performs sync, and manages retries.

methods.name: addCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles addition of a CRD event.

methods.name: updateCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles update of a CRD event.

methods.name: deleteCustomResourceDefinition
